Footer.disclaimer: Tonus generates its analysis automatically from the data you provide. It is not financial, tax, or legal advice.

hero.lede: Upload your statements and verify the numbers — Tonus reads your company's health as objectively as bloodwork reads a person's: a score, the key ratios, and the actions to prioritize.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.stepOneBody: Upload your statements as PDF, XLSX, or CSV — Tonus extracts the figures automatically.
howItWorks.stepTwoBody: Check the extracted numbers against the original document — part of the accuracy step, not a formality.
howItWorks.stepThreeBody: Get your company's health score, a breakdown of the key ratios, and prioritized actions with their expected effect and tradeoffs.

trust.heading: Methodology
trust.pointOpenMethodology: The methodology is open: every formula, weight, and threshold is visible in the product's code.
trust.pointDeterministic: Calculations are deterministic — an AI never computes your numbers; the language model, when connected, only narrates values that are already calculated.
trust.pointTraceable: Every value traces back to specific lines of your document — the formula is shown as a substitution using your own figures.
trust.pointBenchmarks: The source of every industry benchmark is stated in the report¹.
trust.footnote: ¹ Some benchmarks are sourced from Damodaran (NYU Stern), Jan 2026; the rest are marked as demonstration ranges.

privacy.body: Documents are deleted right after the numbers are extracted. Only the figures you confirmed during verification stay in the system — never the file itself.
